4thgear_baseline_pull_11.csv.note: TPS never exceeded 8% and RPM range 2620-2770 with high gear ratio. This is a cruise/warmup snippet, not a 4th-gear WOT baseline. Exclude from baseline averaging.

safety_findings.description: Rear injector hits 100-102% duty cycle at 5900-6100 RPM on every full WOT pull. Stock 31.07 lb/hr injectors are physically maxed on the rear cylinder above ~5500 RPM. Trying to add fuel via VE/lambda above this RPM will produce no actual fueling change because the injector is already at full open. Front cylinder is also high (86-93%) but has some headroom.
safety_findings.recommended_action: Quote injector upgrade (e.g. SE 4.9 g/s / ~38 lb/hr) before any tuning above 5500 RPM. Until then, cap WOT tuning RPM at 5400-5500.

safety_findings.description: Peak HP averaging 89.6 across the three WOT pulls. Stock 103 CVO + Pro Pipes book figure is 100-110 rwhp; this build (with cams) should be in 110-120 range. The shortfall is consistent with high-RPM injector saturation cutting fueling above 5000 RPM. Not a mechanical concern in itself.

VE Rear consistently 10.4 points higher (median) than VE Front across all WOT pulls. Matches expected rear-cylinder heat bias for true-dual exhaust on a counterbalanced TC88B. Confirms dual_bank_weighting is the correct correction strategy when AFR comes back online.
Front and Rear Spark Knock Retard at 0.0 across all pulls. Stock CVO ignition map is healthy at current build state. No knock-event evidence to factor into timing work.

CHT progression across the four pulls: 165 -> 174 -> 180 -> 192 F. Cooling has time to recover between pulls but the rear is loading. Not at oil_temp_rollback_f (280) or anything close, but worth tracking.

next_actions: Fix wideband: verify Innovate LC-2 power, sensor warmup, bung seal, channel mapping front/rear, and that PV3 input voltage range matches LC-2 output. Retake at least 2 4th-gear WOT pulls before any fueling work.
Quote rear injector upgrade to customer (SE part or equivalent ~38 lb/hr). Tuning above 5500 RPM is meaningless until this is resolved.
Once AFR is back, P0 plausibility checks (BSFC closure on 103 ci, BMEP in 120-160 psi band, peak-torque RPM in 3800-4400) can run. Path-1 BSFC will be the cleanest sensor-fault detector.
